TRANSPARENT BY DESIGN

Know what triggers an alert.

These fixed rules flag patterns for review. They do not establish that an account was compromised.

YOUR FIRST INVESTIGATION

From a log line to a finding.

01

Bring the evidence

Load a sample or upload authentication events. Each valid event receives an evidence ID. Invalid records are reported, never silently counted as valid. 

{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-09T09:00:00Z",
  "source_ip": "192.0.2.10",
  "username": "admin",
  "status": "failure"
}

Use ISO timestamps with a timezone. CSV uses the same column names. SSH text must begin with an ISO timestamp; yearless syslog is rejected.

02

Review the pattern

Inspect the rule, its time window, and its supporting events. Repeated failed logins can also come from a forgotten password or a misconfigured service.

“No matching alerts” only means these three rules found nothing. This app does not evaluate every kind of security threat.

03

Explain and investigate

Built-in explanations work immediately. Optional Ollama support runs an AI model on your computer through the companion server.

AI text is an unverified interpretation. Check it against the evidence before drawing conclusions. This assistant does not execute commands or take response actions.

SignalDesk Evidence before assumptions.Local analysis · No billing

Local AI, optional.

Built-in explanations are always available. For model-generated explanations, run this app locally with Ollama.

  1. Install Ollama and download a model, for example ollama pull qwen3:1.7b.
  2. Run npm start in the application folder.
  3. Open http://127.0.0.1:4173 and choose an installed model below.

The model runs on your hardware. No API key or paid service is required. Only the selected alert's normalized evidence is sent to your local model.

Thinking mode is off. Only the final explanation is shown.

Local AI has not been checked.
